policy.acceptedEvidence: SPEECH portrait identity is statically proven; entity direction, action, and damage-state semantics remain unverified.
policy.parityUse: Only portrait mappings may be used as parity evidence; entity mappings remain quarantined until promoted by static binary/data proof.
